title: Question : Distinct on widget rather then globaly

comments.body:
Hi @fvoverscan, sorry for the delayed answer. You can imagine the way how InstantSearch.js works with this: one instance / one request to Algolia. This is not true but you got the idea. That's why you cannot provide distinct at the widget level because each widget is one "parameter" of the search.

With the given record structure I'm not sure this is something achievable. But why do you have to duplicate the content for both the merchant and the product? You can store all the merchants inside the product. Then you can to declare the `merchants.name` as facet, it should solve the issue.

Hi @samouss,
The structure is given to me, i could not change it.
Maybe i could do 2 requests... One for the merchant and the other for the list of product (using the result of the first one) ?

Yes the solution with two requests could work but not with InstantSearch. The library doesn't let you create a dependency between multiple requests. With the provided structure I don't think there is an easy solution (at least I didn't found one).
I'm closing this issue because it's inactive since a while. Feel free to open a new one!
